notes.title: Chapter 5 - Patch 5
notes.notes:
Version 0.5.05

New Features
Quick Menu

 Added a Quick Menu to quickly select between Weapons, Tools, and Consumables. By default, it can be opened by pressing Tab on the keyboard and the Right Stick Button on a gamepad. The binding can be changed via the Title Screen or Pause Menu Settings.
 Pending: A tutorial or message to guide new players in using this feature.


Improvements and Fixes

Fourth Boss Fight

Fixed a case where the boss would not correctly transition between phases.
Tweaked the hitbox in some animations
Added an outline to falling rocks, and adjusted their speed on lower levels to improve visibility and dodging.
Increased regeneration speed per phase, making the combat more dynamic and challenging.
Made the boss HP HUD indicator more responsive when healing and losing HP.


Audio

 The Fleecan can now be heard crying off-screen; also added small SFX when petting and hugging the Fleecan.
 Properly tagged certain sound effects that were not being affected by volume settings.


Level Design

 Bleak Caves: Adjusted enemy positioning and the frequency of falling rock traps.
 Traps: Fixed an issue where enemies would not die upon falling into spiked traps.
 Minor tweaks across multiple areas, including adjustments to object and enemy positioning, collisions, and decorative elements.


Credits

 Updated the text information and adjusted the background music to cycle between different tracks.

notes.title: Chapter 5 - Patch 4
notes.notes:
Version 0.5.04

Quest

 "Melody of the Peaks" Side Quest added, given by Sextus (Valia Town trinkets seller). (This quest guides new players to a vital game mechanic but is also worth checking out for existing players.)
 Sextus Dialogue: Added a first-time dialogue line. In existing save files, he may mention meeting the player for the first time, as this line was not previously implemented.


Cutscenes

 Fixed Fleecan-free cutscene player appearance, now correctly displays the customized player.
 Damerel City camera pan cutscenes: Fixed an issue where the camera would not zoom out as intended due to an error introduced in a previous update.


Player

 Fixed various animation issues related to player layers.


Level Design

 Ruins Dungeon: Improved wall jump sections that were unintentionally more difficult than intended.


Misc

 Various art, dialogue, and level design improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Chapter 5 - Patch 3
notes.notes:
Version: 0.5.03

Story

 Added multiple journal pages scattered in the world as notes, explaining the locations in Chapter 5, their history, key item origins, and Troglund's life journey of discoveries. These notes also convey additional lore and key story points.
 Changed the quest item "Troglund's Journal" to "The Verdant Compendium" to differentiate between the scattered journal pages and the book containing recipes used in the witch's quest.
 Updated the witch's dialogues and the "A Fair Trade" quest to reflect new details about Troglund, his journal pages, his cape, and his compendium.
 Fixed an issue where the dragon would still appear for the riddle event after being defeated.
 Implemented a temporary fix for the quest "A Letter to the King" to ensure it updates correctly even if previous events were not completed in the intended order. (A more permanent fix to prevent early entry into Damerel is pending.)


Settings

 Added two new gameplay settings:

 Directional Evasion:
The Roll and Backflip actions will switch based on the direction of movement.
(Default: Off)

 Prioritize Air Kick:
Pressing Down and Jump in the air will trigger an Air Kick, even if an Air Jump hasn't been performed.
(Default: Off)
These settings depend on acquiring skills in-game and cannot be changed from the Title Screen to avoid spoilers. They must be adjusted from the Pause Menu.
 Improved the "Apply Settings Before Exit" prompt, making it more intuitive and allowing menu exit without saving changes.
 Fixed a glitch where the menu screen could fail to exit under certain conditions after making changes.


Player

 Introduced a fast-walk behavior in swampy waters. The fast-walk action consumes stamina at a lower rate, and resting recovers stamina faster than sprinting.
 Fixed an issue where Riding Fleecan could be interrupted when poisoned or burning.
 Fixed a case where rolling and backflipping could be triggered again without finishing the animation.
 Addressed movement inconsistencies in swamps where actions like jumping or attacking sometimes failed to connect smoothly.
 Fixed various player clothing graphic issues.
 Reviewed collision with spike traps that teleport the player back to the last save zone:
 Fixed cases where multiple hits could occur, making HP loss from these traps consistent at only 1 hit.
 Improved accuracy in determining a safe respawn zone to prevent indefinite respawning onto spikes.

Level Design and Art

 Improved the flow and visuals in various levels.
 Refined the art in the area where the dragon sleeps.
 Optimized memory consumption for multiple sprite assets.


SFX

 Added sound effects to the flame thrower traps.
 Added sound effects to the appearing spears traps.
 Added ambient sounds to the lava in Blazeheart Mountain.
 Added sound effects to moving platforms that previously had no sound.


Enemies

 Croco Lancer: Polished animations; added a new crouch attack to hit below the player's shield.
 Lava Golem: Polished animations; improved accuracy of hitboxes for body and attacks; adjusted HP and damage values.
 Severum Fish: Updated swim chase animation; polished all animations; improved AI behavior for more natural swimming and attacks.
 Static Bat Instances: Corrected red bats to only appear inside Blazing Mountains.


Map

 Added button binding visuals in the Map section for Switching Layers (Ext/Int) and Placing Markers.
 Fixed certain areas not being mapped properly.
 Fixed an issue where the player could be shown on an incorrect map tile.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.4.14
notes.notes:
Player Mechanics and Abilities:

Player Crouch Slide Revision:

Fixed an issue that could prevent hitting the same enemy multiple times with crouch slide kicks.
Reviewed all enemy interactions with the crouch slide. Some enemies may be susceptible to it and trigger a hit animation, others may not react, some may play the hit animation only during certain actions, and others may counter it.
Player Roll & Backflip tweaks: Slightly increased the distance covered for better positioning against enemies. When sprinting, the roll ability now covers slightly more distance.
Player starts a level in the climbing state where intended.
Player Strong Attack Hits reviewed: Strong attacks now push the player slightly further when blocking, with a greatly increased distance traveled when actually hit.

Enemies and AI Behavior:

Severum (Big fish) enemy AI reviewed: Now performs directional thrust bite attacks and has a smoother overall swimming flow.
Snake enemy: Reviewed hitbox accuracy, decreased body damage to 0.25 but added poison to its fang attacks.
Wild-boar enemy: Reviewed hitbox accuracy and made its thrust attack stronger.
Yuson boss combat: Reviewed hitbox accuracy; all attacks are now classified as strong attacks.


Tutorials and Guidance:

Added a Tutorial Message after obtaining the Magic Lamp Tool: Shows how the lamp can be used to burn objects.
Added a Tutorial Message after obtaining the Roll Scroll: Shows how you can dodge enemies.
Added breakable containers with arrows next to the first drawbridge: This hints players and allows replenishment of arrows if needed upon arrival.


Environmental Updates and Fixes:

Forest Underground Area: Fixed a soft-lock that could happen when jumping over a pushable box earlier than intended.
Fixed a soft-lock that could occur when swimming against certain water streams near the Ogres' Ruins Entrance.
Harpoon Launcher in the Catacombs: Can now be blocked with the shield even when standing next to it. Added sound effects.
Environment updates:

Witch's hut now has an animated chimney fire and added fire ambient sound effects.
Damerel City and Castle: Animated some previously static background flags and reviewed other elements.
Falling from the balcony in the City Inn Guest Room or the Castle Guest Room now inflicts no damage.
Various collision and art updates.


UI and Menu Fixes:

Title Screen Option From the Pause Menu Reverted: Fixed an issue introduced in v0.4.11, allowing to return to the Title Screen from the Pause Menu as intended.
